titles.title: Spring
titles.description: A shepherd girl and her loyal dog face ancient forest spirits to bring back the turning of the seasons.

titles.title: Sintel
titles.description: A lonely young woman searches the wild lands for the baby dragon she once rescued and raised.

titles.title: Big Buck Bunny
titles.description: A gentle giant rabbit's peaceful morning is ruined by three mischievous rodents, and he plans a sweet revenge.

titles.title: Tears of Steel
titles.description: In a future Amsterdam, a group of scientists tries to save the world from destructive robots by revisiting a painful breakup.

titles.title: Elephants Dream
titles.description: Two men explore an endless, ever-shifting machine world and disagree about what is real.

titles.title: Caminandes: Llamigos
titles.description: Winter in Patagonia: Koro the llama battles a pesky penguin over the very last berry.

titles.title: Bunny Burrow Tales
titles.description: Short meadow adventures of a big-hearted rabbit and the troublemakers next door.

episodes.title: A Butterfly Morning
episodes.description: The bunny wakes up to a perfect day in the meadow.

episodes.title: Trouble in the Trees
episodes.description: Three rodents decide the bunny is the perfect target.

episodes.title: The Big Plan
episodes.description: Enough is enough: the bunny builds his traps.

titles.title: Steel Protocol
titles.description: A last-stand team in a ruined city races to rewrite one memory before the machines win.

episodes.title: The Oude Kerk
episodes.description: The team gathers in the church and briefs the plan.

episodes.title: Bridge Point
episodes.description: The machines close in while the simulation boots.

episodes.title: Second Chance
episodes.description: One memory, one conversation, one last try.
